title.narrative: TO51 Inclusive Education in Shinyanga and Mwanza Regions, Tanzania

description.narrative: This Task Order will directly support 2,500 girls and boys with disabilities across 15 Wards in Shinyanga rural, Shinyanga MC and Misungwi districts to access and participate in primary and pre-primary education on an equal basis to their peers. This will be achieved through the collaboration of a wide range of stakeholders, including OPDs, parents, communities, teachers, headteachers and Ward, District, Regional and National Government Officials.
